description: Write acceptance tests for the routing module in test/acceptance/routing.test.js from .hub/spec.md and the interface JSDoc only (do not read or rely on implementation details). Cover documented behavior, exact strings, error classes and codes, and edge cases. No network: inject fake fetch, sources and routers. Tests may fail until the module is built.
summary: Added test/acceptance/routing.test.js: 37 acceptance tests covering VALHALLA_ENDPOINT/MAX_AVOID, buildValhallaRequest exact body and rounding, parseValhallaResponse decoding and leg joining, ValhallaRouter POST/User-Agent/endpoint and error mapping (442/171 NoRouteError, other non-2xx, network or bad JSON UpstreamError, >50 avoid InputError), and StubRouter straight line, dog-leg order (left then right of travel, nearest first), fewest-hits fallback, distance/duration and determinism. No network and no geo dependency. They fail with NotImplementedError until routing is built; all pass against a spec-only reference implementation kept outside the repo. Interpretations logged as routing-tests.1 and routing-tests.2.
title: Acceptance tests for Valhalla and stub routers
